## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change made.

## Evidence

- Tests or reproduction commands:
- Behavior cases or controls, when claims concern instruction behavior:
- Known failures and limits:

## Provenance

- Source and redistribution terms for any added instruction asset:
- Modification notice for any derivative asset:

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `ruff format --check .`, `ruff check .`, `mypy denser`, and `pytest`.
- [ ] New or changed public functions have useful docstrings.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, cookies, private prompts, personal paths, or raw authentication diagnostics.
- [ ] I did not overwrite or rewrite committed raw evidence to hide a failure.
- [ ] Performance or behavior claims link to reproducible evidence and state their limits.
- [ ] Added third-party material has a verified license, attribution, and modification notice.
